decisions.reason: Comma is unnecessary in a not-X-but-Y construction.
Present perfect and present match 아까부터 and the sweat she is seeing now.
Realized and the merged discovery are more precise than a vague I understood.
끌어 올리는 is raising condition to a peak, not restoring it; 과 동시에 is kept.
Ever matches 없었던; since Synchronization fits 이후에도.
Dream about is the natural English for 무슨 꿈을 꾼 거지.
Needs both 만 (just) and 하지만 (but); each candidate drops one.
decisions.replacement: My head just throbbed, but I couldn’t remember the dream at all.

decisions.reason: Speaker tag correctly moves into the following dialogue line.
In a worried voice keeps 걱정스러운 목소리로; merged tag is natural.
Suffer alone is the natural rendering of 혼자 앓지 말고.
Faced with her serious expression matches 표정에 할 말이 없어진.
진짜 없어 is Really, not Are you sure; the two-beat 고민/힘든 일 stays tighter.
Still is extra; the contractions match the narrator’s voice.
Who’d and kids keep the conversational narration; children is a register lift.
Overcoming matches 극복; the dash joins the two beats cleanly.
Pretended captures 척, which like nothing was wrong only implies.
Deliberately made a face is the natural collocation for 짐짓.
그런데 here pivots to a new topic, not a contrastive But.
Expected to hear completes the elliptical name line without changing the surprise.
몸이 is body, not 전신; whole is unsupported.
Ponytail radish kimchi is the specific food 총각김치, not generic young-radish kimchi.
The causal fragment matches the short 때문이다 beat.
Calling that name matches 그 이름을 부르더라고; calling it is awkward.
Come back is the conversational 돌아왔고; returned is a synonym swap.
Show up matches the colloquial thought-voice; appear is a register lift.
Keep the 때문일까 question and 떠올랐다, but 단어 is word, not term.
decisions.replacement: My head was a mess. Was it an aftereffect of Murim? The word PTSD came to mind—post-traumatic stress disorder.

decisions.reason: The grim/hardened beat moves into the following merged line.
Expression hardened matches 표정이 굳은; looked grim paraphrases it away.
Hurriedly made an excuse matches 황급히 변명하며; precious moment restores 소중한 순간.
평소대로 돌아왔다 is returned to normal, not faded.
Even keeps 낮잠까지; SOL drops that concession.
Complete sentence matches 때다 better than a telegraphic fragment.
Dripping from Mom’s words keeps 미련이 뚝뚝 떨어지는; naked and voice are unsupported.
She is the one worrying; 저 정도면 is that’s enough, not at this rate.
Prepared matches 준비해 둔; even this / only after captures 이것도 겨우…끝에.
There’s nowhere to put them is the tighter thought for 넣을 곳도 없는데.
The fridge itself matches the correction 들여놓을 자리도 없다.
Looking at moving is awkward; looking for a new place is natural 이사.
Last night matches 어젯밤; the night before is an unnecessary recast.
Put in is the natural backpack verb; inside is churn.
BASE is ungrammatical; SOL loses the cleft 다급해진 건 가족들이었다 and 의아함에.
decisions.replacement: When I set the backpack down, puzzled, it was my family who suddenly got frantic.

decisions.reason: The added comma is optional churn.
You’ll miss is tighter spoken rhythm for 늦겠다.
Though? keeps the contrastive challenge in 건데?
SOL adds you’ll have to pay; the source is just the repeated surcharge.
What was going on supplies the object of 감을 잡았다 without changing it.
Faces answered for them is the natural idiom for 표정이 곧 대답이다.
Present need matches a standing instruction 필요할 때.
Keep making plenty is the natural continuation of 앞으로도 그럴 거고요.
거짓 is lie, not fiction; half truth, half lie matches 반반.
Go up in smoke is the English idiom for 물거품으로 사라질; vanish like smoke is a weaker calque.
말문이 턱 막혔다 is speechless, not stopped me cold; 다음 순간 stays.
Keep 도 (either); that’s all Mom needs is more spoken than that’s enough for Mom.
decisions.replacement: “Don’t push yourself. Don’t get hurt, either. That’s all Mom needs.”

decisions.reason: What else could I say is tighter and drops an extra supposed to.
The stepping-out line merges with the bags/backpack beat.
Merge the 메고서 line, but keep 습한 공기; SOL drops air.
decisions.replacement: A little later, I stepped out into the humid air of a summer night with shopping bags full of side dishes and a backpack stuffed with bundles of cash.

decisions.reason: Throughout matches 내내; dropping the extra comma cleans the pair.
Someone’s voice restores 누군가의; BASE omits it.
Remembered spoken voice stays quoted; SOL italics drop 란 말이다.
촤아악 is a spray/gush, not a slash Sshhk.
솟구쳤다 is spurted, not sprayed; keep SOL’s parallel human blood and naturalized thigh beat.
decisions.replacement: Blood spurted. Not the green blood of a monster, but the red blood of a human. My thigh burned as I rammed my spear into the Lizardman Chieftain’s chest.

decisions.reason: Gate cleared keeps the clipped game-clear beat of 게이트 클리어.
SOL forces one finger and names injuries early; 곳곳을 가리켰다 is pointing to spots.
Which was still bleeding adds weight with no gain.
Plural grazes matches the three injuries just indicated.
Something was different restores 뭔가 달랐다.
Keeps 감정 and 단순한 걱정; SOL drops the emotion seeping from the look.
Even once keeps 한 번도; the clipped same Gate, same monsters matches his speech.
향했다 is turned toward, not settled on.
Keep 결국 and 다섯 군데; ended up captures 입고 말았다.
decisions.replacement: Time passed, but things didn’t improve. In the end, on the fourth day, I ended up with injuries in five places.

decisions.reason: Head a mess matches the established 복잡했다 rendering; turmoil is a synonym lift.
뭐가 문제지 is what’s the problem, not what’s wrong with me.
Some three hundred million matches 상당; the money is in the account, not merely I had.
Those is an added demonstrative; damn dreams already covers 빌어먹을 꿈.
Keep started; ever since / I’d been having captures 이후부터 as an ongoing state.
decisions.replacement: That was when it started. Ever since my first night at my family’s house, I’d been having nightmares.

decisions.reason: By the night is unsupported; restored changes 끌어 올려; only multiplied keeps 만.
곤란 is that this will be a problem, not I can’t go on.
So…that is the natural English construction.
물었다 is asked, not stared.
Keep the separate answer tag with the literal assembly line.
조립 is assembly, not reassembly; the manual-speak is the joke.
들고 is in hand; 노래진다 is went yellow, not flashed.
decisions.replacement: He was sitting in front of the capsule with a screwdriver in hand. For a second, my vision went yellow.

decisions.reason: 한국말은 끝까지 들어야지 is the idiom hear me out, not a literal claim about Korean.
Restore 표정을 보니; 흘러나왔다 is a sigh slipping out, not I let out.
decisions.replacement: Judging by his expression, he didn’t look like he was lying. Only after I checked that the capsule was still intact did a sigh of relief slip out.

decisions.reason: Bewildered is the clearer rendering of 당황한.
Keeps 하나 and the what happened to tossing it line; unwanted and dumped add force.
정체불명 is unidentified, not mysterious.
얼굴 is face, not expression.
해프닝 is episode; 기분이다 is it felt like, not a factual draining.
Keep 장난 아냐 as no joke and 오늘도 as again; SOL’s insane and came over overreach.
decisions.replacement: “Complaints about you have been no joke lately. The guy next door raised a fuss again today. I barely calmed him down and sent him off.”

decisions.reason: Scooped up / went on is more vivid; across and continued are synonym churn.
Keep groaning matches the repeated nights; the question stays present is.
보였다 is I saw; SOL drops the perception.
Clipped She pretty? How old? matches Jinho’s rapid-fire 예뻐? 몇 살?
Guy matches 저 인간; first-person lament matches 통탄을 금치 못하겠다.
The name’s a bit exotic matches 이름이 좀; sounds is added.
The shrug fragment matches 아니지, 뭐.
Even restores 이나 in 100일이나 채우겠냐.
아니 이 새끼가 is a vocative outburst, not what is this bastard doing.
SOL drops 분노하는; he is getting angry at the realization.
Keep 침대에서; merging the muttered line is fine.
decisions.replacement: Once the room was quiet, I sat up on the bed and went over to the capsule. I tapped its old, grime-caked surface and muttered, “What the hell are you?”

decisions.reason: The quoted line is absorbed into the previous sentence.
당연하게도 is naturally, not as expected.
Secretly hoping is the natural collocation for 내심 기대; too bad matches 아쉽다.
아무리…오래라지만 concedes the fact; might have adds unsupported doubt.
소설로 쓴다면 is if I wrote it as a novel, not if it were a novel.
푸흐흐 / 바람 빠지는 소리 is a deflating sound, not a chuckle.
Keeps 가능할 in the trailing denial that the next beat reverses.
뒤집어쓴 is dumped over the head; SOL adds bucket and recasts it as a thought hitting him.
decisions.replacement: It was like ice water dumped over my head. My mind snapped clear.

decisions.reason: Now matches 현재; today is churn.
The comma keeps two proofs, invasion and Gates; 그 증거 is the proof.
Keeps 현실; SOL adds passages and replaces reality with our world.
못한 is inability, not merely had never set foot.
This capsule in front of me matches 눈앞의 이 캡슐.
Experienced is the natural rendering of 겪은.
Even captures 까지도; too only covers 도.
